t: Praying for people who were doing the work
a: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ الْخَيْرَ خَيْرُ الآخِرَهْ فَاغْفِرْ لِلأَنْصَارِ وَالْمُهَاجِرَهْ
p: Allāhumma inna-l-khayra khayru-l-ākhirah, fa-ghfir li-l-anṣāri wa-l-muhājirah.
m: O Allah, the real good is the good of the Hereafter, so forgive the Anṣār and the Muhājirūn.
